newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Coast Guard to transfer stranded tanker cargo.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Coast Guard to transfer stranded tanker cargo.

text.p: Salvage crews plan to transfer part of a cargo of highly dangerous liquefied gas from a stranded tanker to another vessel on Thursday, the Coast Guard said on Monday.
The second tanker, the Selam Kosan, is due to arrive in Miami from Puerto Rico on Monday night, a Coast Guard statement said.
The stranded ship, the German-flagged Igloo Moon, has been stuck about three miles south of Cape Florida, Key Biscayne, since last Wednesday.
It was carrying a cargo of liquefied butadiene, a potentially explosive gas, from the Middle East to Houston.
Salvage crews have already unloaded fuel in an effort to refloat the vessel.
"Pending weather conditions, the actual transfer of the butadiene cargo may be initiated Thursday morning," the statement said.
The area is an aquatic preserve but the Coast Guard said so far there had been no pollution from the Igloo Moon.
